text_simplified: Allah the Exalted divided the state of spouses regarding offspring into females, males, both, or barrenness, and He mentioned females first to honor them, so a servant must never resent what Allah has bestowed upon him. Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal (may Allah have mercy on him) used to remind anyone blessed with a daughter that the prophets (peace be upon them) were fathers of daughters, and how often a single daughter has brought comfort, happiness, and contentment to her parents' eyes and hearts.
